subject: BeaconAI POC: connectivity cutover & MAP milestones
messages:
From: Ben Harris <ben.harris@beaconai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: BeaconAI - POC MAP & environment details

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team at BeaconAI is excited to move into a short POC to validate inference latency and cost under our production-like workload. To scope the Mutual Action Plan and finalize a cutover window, we need a clear checklist for environment setup. Primary asks up-front:

- API credentials and recommended client configuration (we'll need per-org API keys + example python snippet).
- Guidance on org setup / service accounts (who creates the Redwood org vs. what we do on our side).
- IP allowlist ranges (for our egress, and what Redwood expects).
- VPC peering requirements and estimated lead time (network team availability the week of 7/5) and any firewall rules.

Target timeline from our side: POC kickoff the week of 7/8 with a hard cutover test on 7/15. Can Redwood support that cadence? If you send a MAP template, we'll plug in our internal owners and availability.

Also: two success metrics we care about for the POC: 95th percentile token latency under 150ms for 512-token context, and average cost per 1k tokens below $0.45. We understand these may need canary rollouts and fallback model policies.

Thanks — I can loop in our infra lead if helpful.

Ben Harris
Head of ML Ops, BeaconAI
ben.harris@beaconai.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Harris <ben.harris@beaconai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BeaconAI - POC MAP & environment details

Hi Ben — great to hear the team is ready to move. I've sketched a concise MAP below to align owners and the environment checklist. Attached is a fillable MAP template that you can return with your owners and target windows.

High-level MAP (proposed):

Phase 0 — Kickoff (by 7/6)
- Share filled MAP template (BeaconAI)
- Confirm primary contacts for infra and security (BeaconAI)

Phase 1 — Org & Credentials (7/6 - 7/8)
- Redwood creates a dedicated BeaconAI org in the Console (owner: Marissa)
- Issue scoped API keys (per-environment keys: staging/prod-mock) and client example (owner: Marissa)
- Provide service-account recommendations and minimum scopes (owner: Marissa)

Phase 2 — Network Enablement (7/8 - 7/12)
- Provide Redwood IP allowlist and peering requirements (owner: BeaconAI / ops)
- Schedule VPC peering window (30-90 minute maintenance) and provide firewall contact (owner: BeaconAI)

Phase 3 — Canary & Cost Controls (7/13 - 7/15)
- Canary traffic test with fallback policy and KV/cache warmup (owner: BeaconAI + Redwood SRE)
- Validate latency & cost SLOs (joint)

Phase 4 — Acceptance (7/15)
- Sign-off on acceptance criteria and next steps for expansion

Notes / technical attachments included: sample client config, token-budget guidelines, and an api-key rotation schedule. Please fill the attached MAP template and return as soon as practical. If your network team prefers, we can provide a short peering checklist for your firewall engineer.

I attached: redwood-poc-map-template.xlsx (small workbook to fill owners and windows).

Short answer on cadence: yes, the 7/8 kickoff with 7/15 acceptance is doable if we lock owners and peering availability by 7/6.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-poc-map-template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Harris <ben.harris@beaconai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: BeaconAI Ops <ops@beaconai.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BeaconAI - POC MAP & environment details

Marissa — thanks for the MAP. We're returning a few items inline and attaching our network diagram.

- Owners: Infra = Sam Li (sam.li@beaconai.com), Security = Priya Anand (priya.anand@beaconai.com).
- Peering: we can open a peering window on 7/9 or 7/11 (preferred 7/11 morning PT).
- Firewall / egress: our firewall team needs the specific Redwood egress IP CIDRs and the manifest of inbound ports; I'll have them scope rules once we receive the ranges.

We attached: beaconai-network-diagram.pdf (high level).

On metrics: we can meet the latency target in controlled canaries; cost threshold will depend on batching/kernel choices — so please include recommended quantization model variants if you have them.

Quoted for visibility:
> Phase 2 — Network Enablement (7/8 - 7/12)
> - Provide Redwood IP allowlist and peering requirements (owner: BeaconAI / ops)
> - Schedule VPC peering window (30-90 minute maintenance) and provide firewall contact (owner: BeaconAI)

Ben Harris
Head of ML Ops, BeaconAI
ben.harris@beaconai.com

Attachments: beaconai-network-diagram.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: BeaconAI - POC MAP & environment details

Team — forwarding BeaconAI's responses and the attached network diagram. Action items to own on our end before 7/6 so we can hit the 7/8 kickoff: 

- Vivek: prepare the peering checklist and finalize the Redwood egress CIDRs. Can you confirm an allocation and a primary contact for the peering tunnel? Target: deliver CIDRs + peering checklist by 7/2.

- Hannah: draft the canary rollback policy and the model-variant fallback (include a short runbook for SRE). Target: 7/5.

- Aditya: quick cost/back-of-envelope for token budget under multiple batching configs and a recommended quantization variant to meet BeaconAI's cost target. Target: 7/4.

I'll prepare the org and API key issuance next week (I will create the BeaconAI org and scoped keys on 7/6). Once we have BeaconAI's filled MAP and confirmed peering date (they suggested 7/11 morning PT), we'll lock the cutover slot.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2027-0091) — I'll update the MAP attachment there and add the DocuSign peering agreement placeholder link.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: none
